scenes.label: Evening home and new guest
scenes.viewpoints: Narrator plus only explicitly stated private thoughts; never assume shared knowledge.

scenes.label: Shopping encounter
scenes.viewpoints: Narrator plus only explicitly stated private thoughts; never assume shared knowledge.
scenes.knowledge: Bobby is asked about but is absent; Bantu states he came alone.
scenes.dialogue: Bantu calls out; Dhika asks why he is present and asks about Bobby; Bantu requests company; Dhika agrees.

scenes.label: Shopping discussion and purchases
scenes.viewpoints: Narrator plus only explicitly stated private thoughts; never assume shared knowledge.
scenes.knowledge: Bantu's preferences and Dhika's purchase intentions are distinct; no unspoken intention may be presumed from requests.
scenes.dialogue: Requests, objections, practical sizing suggestions, return questions and purchase decision; no further encounter is established by this.
scenes.mechanic: clothing task as dialogue anchor, iterative suggestion-response

scenes.label: Home and departure to neighbor
scenes.viewpoints: Narrator plus only explicitly stated private thoughts; never assume shared knowledge.
scenes.knowledge: Pappu focuses on promised park outing; Dhika notices open-door urgency; Uncle's arrival has not yet occurred in this window.
scenes.dialogue: Dhika tells Pappu to wait and calls to Aunty.
scenes.mechanic: minor domestic omission becomes a later visitor's entrance condition

scenes.label: Neighbor conversation and travel commitment
scenes.viewpoints: Narrator plus only explicitly stated private thoughts; never assume shared knowledge.
scenes.knowledge: Dhika knows her prior view of Uncle; Uncle explains his arrival and travel plans; John is not present.
scenes.dialogue: Uncle explains open door; Dhika invites conversation; Uncle apologizes; Dhika states a future boundary; Uncle requests help for Aunty.
scenes.mechanic: interruption -> agency -> apology -> stated boundary -> external practical obligation

scenes.label: Birthday and family logistics
scenes.viewpoints: Narrator plus only explicitly stated private thoughts; never assume shared knowledge.
scenes.knowledge: John and Dhika attend family plans; narrator compresses multiple days.
scenes.dialogue: Not recorded in this brief time passage.
scenes.mechanic: time compression with explicit event anchors

scenes.label: Friday scheduling and task planning
scenes.viewpoints: Narrator plus only explicitly stated private thoughts; never assume shared knowledge.
scenes.knowledge: Twins are informed tuition is canceled; Maami confirms Chotu is available; next painting session is not yet completed.
scenes.dialogue: Notification to twins; call to Maami; participant responses partially reported.
scenes.mechanic: dormant practical project resumes after canceled parallel thread

scenes.label: Room-painting work
scenes.viewpoints: Narrator plus only explicitly stated private thoughts; never assume shared knowledge.
scenes.knowledge: Chotu and Dhika share the painting task; private assumptions remain person-specific.
scenes.dialogue: Dhika greets; Chotu replies; clothing/work comfort topic arises; then painting task begins.
scenes.mechanic: ordinary work setting and small dialogue turns

scenes.label: Paint accident and practical response
scenes.time_or_location: Friday, work area / spare clothing arrangement
scenes.viewpoints: Narrator plus only explicitly stated private thoughts; never assume shared knowledge.
scenes.knowledge: Paint spill is accidental; apology and later correction are not advance plans.
scenes.dialogue: Chotu apologizes for spill; Dhika reassures and arranges replacement work clothing.
scenes.mechanic: practical interruption -> apology -> non-graphic logistical repair

scenes.label: End of workday and next meeting
scenes.viewpoints: Narrator plus only explicitly stated private thoughts; never assume shared knowledge.
scenes.knowledge: An agreed plan for tomorrow does not establish actual arrival tomorrow.
scenes.dialogue: Dhika proposes continuation at noon; Chotu explicitly accepts.
scenes.mechanic: exact-time continuity hook and reciprocal acceptance
scenes.exit: next-day noon return agreed, not yet happened
